source_gap_claims.behavior: Enforce validator trust through a pre-evaluation, candidate-external trust envelope that freezes validator content, complete semantic-dependency identities, support policy, and scope; invalidate it if any member is missing, ambiguous, or changed.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations independently verify several trust properties, but none requires this pre-evaluation trust-envelope lifecycle and its complete frozen binding.
source_gap_claims.subject: Validator trust envelope

source_gap_claims.behavior: Define semantic-dependency closure as all executable, data, policy, configuration, and environment representations that can affect target selection, verdict, diagnostic category, or evidence validity, without narrowing it by Probe reachability.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligation verifies semantic-dependency closure but does not represent the required exhaustive categories or the prohibition on Probe-reachability narrowing.
source_gap_claims.subject: Semantic-dependency closure

source_gap_claims.behavior: Restrict every retained evaluation seed classification to anchor_candidate, challenge_candidate, or non_baseline_exploratory_candidate.
source_gap_claims.reason: The seed obligations require an approved non-baseline classification but do not constrain it to the closed classification set.
source_gap_claims.subject: Evaluation-seed classification

source_gap_claims.behavior: Require every Matrix Case to own a distinct fixture or state transition, beyond merely having distinct inputs or separating Stable and Candidate state.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations require pairwise-distinct Matrix Case inputs and Stable/Candidate fixture-state separation, but neither requires a distinct fixture or state transition owned by each case.
source_gap_claims.subject: Matrix Case fixture or state-transition ownership

source_gap_claims.behavior: Demonstrate preserved behavior for unaffected Matrix Cases.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation requires unaffected cases to establish preserved behavior.
source_gap_claims.subject: Unaffected Matrix Cases

source_gap_claims.behavior: Invalidate the aggregate when an expected output or expectation is forged.
source_gap_claims.reason: Expected-difference validity is constrained, but no obligation rejects forged expected output or expectation outside that expected-difference condition.
source_gap_claims.subject: Expectation-forged Matrix evidence

source_gap_claims.behavior: Prevent a success path from making a required Consumer route check unreachable.
source_gap_claims.reason: Manifest reconciliation and actual invocation bindings do not require that every required route check remain reachable on a success path.
source_gap_claims.subject: Required Consumer route checks

source_gap_claims.behavior: For re-enable, invoke the current approved Candidate Route and capture its current result.
source_gap_claims.reason: The re-enable obligation requires execution through a real call surface but does not require the Candidate Route, current approval, or capture of the current result.
source_gap_claims.subject: Re-enable transition

source_gap_claims.behavior: Preserve failed-Candidate evidence while adding new Consumer and rollback evidence append-only.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations preserve historical records and append repair/runtime evidence, but do not preserve failed-Candidate evidence.
source_gap_claims.subject: Failed-Candidate evidence

source_gap_claims.behavior: Restrict terminal categories to the declared set and prohibit a serialized alias from merging a failure into success or silently reinterpreting a terminal category.
source_gap_claims.reason: Deterministic terminal state and unsuccessful budget exhaustion do not cover terminal-category preservation or alias semantics.
source_gap_claims.subject: Terminal result categories

source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject creation of another TC-D1 requirement tree.
source_gap_claims.reason: The scope obligations exclude roadmap work and features but do not prohibit a replacement TC-D1 requirement tree.
source_gap_claims.subject: TC-D1 requirement-tree boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject redesign of Skill-input v1/current-pointer semantics while retaining current Skill-input v2 behavior.
source_gap_claims.reason: Snapshot binding mentions Skill-input v2 but no obligation rejects redesign of the legacy v1/current-pointer semantics.
source_gap_claims.subject: Skill-input semantic boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: Allow Consumer-transition omission only when its exception is approved by an existing authorized repository or ADR owner; until such confirmation and binding exist, no exception exists.
source_gap_claims.reason: The applicability-exception obligation requires pre-execution approval and binding but does not constrain the approving authority or enforce the stated no-exception default.
source_gap_claims.subject: Consumer Manifest exception authority
